login.note: Manual, by a human, in this profile — always (ADR-0008). Username/password, or 'continue with Facebook'; a new browser usually draws a 'save your login info' and often a code. Automated sign-in is the fastest way to get the account restricted.

logout.note: UNVERIFIED, and deliberately not guessed. /accounts/logout/ is a POST that needs the X-CSRFToken header (the csrftoken cookie); the GET form of it has not been driven from this fork. Clear the profile's instagram.com cookies instead.

traps: One shared browser, no mutex. Two lanes attach to a nondeterministic tab. Run `chrome-agent goto <url>` then `chrome-agent status` before believing any read.

instagram:profile scrapes the CURRENT page and wants an open profile grid; instagram:post wants an open post, not a profile root. Pointed at the wrong page a read can still 'succeed' — on 2026-09-12 `verify instagram.com` ran against whatever the tab held, scraped REDDIT, found images and stamped instagram verified. Navigate first, then read.

The probe reads `ds_user_id`, the readable half of the session (sessionid is HttpOnly). It is an account ID, never a handle, and it can outlive the session cookie — so a true verdict here is weaker evidence than LinkedIn's or Reddit's API probes.
No write verb exists for this site. Do not improvise one by driving the DOM.
Verification rule: read the artifact back from the live page. A 2xx proves nothing here, and on some of these sites neither does a 5xx.
notes: Converted from the CLI's `_auth_probe_js` case branch, `_verify_fixture` (instagram:profile | https://www.instagram.com/instagram/) and playbooks/instagram.com/ (last_verified: 2026-09-12, recipe:instagram:profile). That stamp is from AFTER the wrong-page bug was fixed. Read-only here.
